Eight backings/views additionally cover every split boundary, marks/cursors/reference counts, copied/stack patterns, independent Reset and concurrent factory reuse; deterministic random sessions use a separate sliding-window model. The original AHO_CORASIC parameter is now implemented for all five original test methods, completing all three original algorithms. Aho-Corasick additionally runs the existing fragmentation, pattern-copy, independent Reset/random-model and concurrent-factory scenarios (29 added cases). Span-only factory extensions continue to apply to KMP/Bitap.
